text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa―――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(This burning heat coursing through my 
whole body... this surge of 
excitement...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Truly, running is... racing is—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's so—so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (I remember—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That day when I learned 'maintenance' and 
'management' from Sensei, and realized 
that I, too, had the ability to race.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Discovering the pure joy of running on my 
own two legs, and dreaming of what it 
would be like to enter a race like this— 
oh, the exhilaration I felt back then—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It's beyond my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The real race is far hotter, far more 
heart-pounding than anything I ever 
imagined back then...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I won't forget this. The feelings I felt 
today are sure to be essential for running 
over the long haul—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning after finishing her debut race, 
Ikuno Dictus showed no apparent signs of 
physical distress.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I feel more fulfilled in 
both body and mind than before I entered 
the race...!"
choice_data_list:
Sounds like it turned out to be a great 
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...I feel absolutely amazing."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My spirits are so high that I want to 
train right this second, but... I must 
keep my composure here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now. Let us return to the waiting room at 
once and "record" this.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—Measurement complete. Estimated fatigue: 
65%. Within normal parameters with no 
impact on daily activity, though a 
considerable amount of fatigue has 
accumulated.”

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"‘Proposing actions for fatigue recovery. 
Please confirm.’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Regarding the measurement results, 
there is no discrepancy with my 
self-analysis. What are your thoughts on 
the proposed action plan?
choice_data_list:
It still feels a bit stiff and formal, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ikuno Dictus and I had 'IRON WILL' 
measure and record Ikuno Dictus's 
post-race condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By doing this, the goal is to make the 
management support AI equipped on "IRON 
WILL" “learn.”
choice_data_list:
Given how that race went, we might need 
some icing too

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"IRON WILL is still only capable of 
offering safe suggestions. In a bad way, 
you could call it mechanical."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I plan to record these flexible real-world 
responses, have it learn from them, and 
improve its accuracy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So both I and "IRON WILL" will grow 
stronger through races like this, won't 
we?
choice_data_list:
Same here, I'm planning to keep getting 
stronger too.

Same here, I'm planning to keep getting 
stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, I intend to keep hungrily 
acquiring knowledge and putting it to use. 
It's all for—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—In order to keep running longer than 
anyone, and pile up more victories than 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then let us grow stronger together. So 
that we may fight our way through whatever 
lies ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ikuno Dictus's debut race came to 
a successful conclusion—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and I were having a meeting 
to set our goals for the Junior Class.
choice_data_list:
—Let's make the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies 
our goal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...! Aiming for... a GⅠ race...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's expression stiffened. 
That's just how well she understands how 
difficult running in a GⅠ truly is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, that goes for myself as well. 
Umamusume who run in GⅠ races are the 
elite of the elite. There's no doubt they 
are a select few. But—
choice_data_list:
I need to run to advance on the Tiara 
route

We should run to advance on the Tiara 
route

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Ikuno Dictus is an Umamusume who aims 
to run more and grow stronger than anyone 
else—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her distance aptitude, there's 
no doubt she should aim for the top along 
the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is a 
Junior-class mile GⅠ contested by many 
aspiring to the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you've resolved to aim for the Tiara 
route, you shouldn't hesitate to make this 
GⅠ race your goal...!
choice_data_list:
――Let's challenge ourselves boldly and get 
stronger

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the Classic stage, she should 
proudly challenge the Triple Tiara as a 
top-tier Umamusume...!
choice_data_list: I believe that if it's you, you can do it.
I believe that you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much, Trainer. Knowing 
you have such faith in me is truly 
encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume... as someone aiming for 
the Classic races—that dream stage—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I want to challenge the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And I will... become a GⅠ Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A spark of determination flashes in her 
eyes. When she's like this, Ikuno Dictus 
will march forward without stopping.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: “—Please state your business.”
choice_data_list:
For our next target race, let's go with 
the Hanshin JF!

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"‘Target set for the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies.’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I must train even harder. Far, far 
harder than I ever have—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I'd like nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with our sights set on our next 
goal, the Hanshin JF, our Junior Class 
days officially kicked off...!
